eyebrow: Building the four two-qubit basis states
code:
ket0 = np.array([1, 0])
ket1 = np.array([0, 1])

np.kron(ket0, ket1)   # |01>
# [0 1 0 0]

np.kron(ket1, ket0)   # |10>
# [0 0 1 0]
caption: Two 2-dimensional vectors combine into one 4-dimensional vector — not two tracked side by side.

code:
P0 = np.outer(ket0, ket0)
P1 = np.outer(ket1, ket1)
CNOT = np.kron(P0, I) + np.kron(P1, X)

state_10 = np.kron(ket1, ket0)   # |10>
CNOT @ state_10
# [0 0 0 1]   -> |11>, target flipped
caption: The target flips from 0 to 1 precisely because the control qubit was |1> — CNOT's defining behavior, verified.
